title: Terms of service
summary: PrediGol is a sports-analysis and value-detection platform for people aged 18 or over. It does not guarantee results or profits, it is not a bookmaker and it does not take money for bets.

blocks.p: PrediGol is a sports-analysis and value-detection platform: it shows match data, probabilities computed by its models, odds published by bookmakers and analysis of all of it, and it points out when PrediGol's probability is higher than the one the market pays. The service is provided by {{controller.name}}, domiciled at {{controller.address}}.

PrediGol is not a bookmaker or a gambling operator: it takes no bets, takes no money for bets, pays no winnings and acts as an intermediary for no operator. It has no links to place bets and promotes no operator. The only money PrediGol receives is that of its own membership (section 5).

sections.title: 2. No guarantee of results or profits

blocks.p: A probability says what is likely, not what will happen. No forecast, pick, parlay or figure of PrediGol guarantees a result, a profit or any other benefit, and past results do not ensure future ones.
What you do with the information is your decision and your responsibility. PrediGol is not liable for losses from bets you place with third parties.

sections.title: 3. For people aged 18 or over only

blocks.p: You must be 18 or over to use PrediGol. By creating your account you declare that you are. PrediGol does not ask for documents, but it will close the account of anyone who does not meet this requirement.

Your account is personal and non-transferable. You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for what is done with your account. If you suspect someone else is using it, change the password, sign out the other sessions from your profile and tell us.
You can turn on two-step verification from your profile; we recommend it.
Access to PrediGol may require a paid, monthly membership. You start with a free trial, with full access and no card, whose length you see in your profile.
The current price, in Colombian pesos or in US dollars, as you choose, is shown in your profile (Membership) before you pay.

Until there is a payment gateway, you pay by the means we agree with you and PrediGol records the payment by hand: there is no automatic charge and PrediGol keeps no card or account numbers. The start, expiry, renewal, suspension and refunds are recorded by PrediGol and told to you in the app and through the contact channels. PrediGol may offer coupons and discounts, and shows you their conditions before you pay.
[Pending the lawyer's review (P5): payment methods, taxes (VAT), renewal, the 5-business-day right of withdrawal and its exceptions, refunds and the complaints channel.]
You may not:

ul: share your account or resell PrediGol's information;
extract data automatically, interfere with the service or try to reach other users' data;
use PrediGol for illegal purposes or to promote betting operators.

blocks.p: PrediGol may suspend or close an account that breaches these terms, telling you why.

Results, line-ups, statistics and odds come from external providers and from bookmakers, and may contain errors or delays. PrediGol corrects them when it detects them and, if a result changes after settlement, settles again and keeps a record.
The service may be interrupted for maintenance or for reasons beyond our control. PrediGol will do what is reasonable to keep it available, without guaranteeing it.
PrediGol's texts, models, analysis and design belong to its provider. You may use them for your personal use; you may not copy or distribute them without permission.
How we process your data is in the Personal data processing policy. How we understand responsible gaming is on its page. Both are part of these terms.

If we change something important in these terms, we will ask you to accept them again before you go on using PrediGol. Each version is dated and has its fingerprint (sha256), and your profile shows which version you accepted and when.
These terms are governed by Colombian law. You can send complaints or claims to {{controller.email}}. If you are not satisfied, you can turn to the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC).
